title: Kasia Triantafelo (Buffer): 'Buffer is on the path to become one of the incorruptible ones'
summary: Triantafelo works in operations and automations at Buffer. She listed Incorruptible among the books she read through Buffer's book benefit, which pays for staff reading.
blockquote: Every word kept showing me how Buffer is on the path to become one of the incorruptible ones.
